analysis_status: Prospective project-new full-pipeline neural-generator audit. Target outcomes have not been used for development or configuration selection.

partition.sampling_design: Disjoint equal-allocation stratified samples within the two registered outcome classes. The estimand is the balanced target population induced by this design.

generator_search.name: random-feature denoising autoencoder
generator_search.description: Each mechanism draw independently samples the hidden layer, fits the reconstruction map on the fixed source table, samples a synthetic release, and refits the proxy classifier.

selection_rule.high_fidelity: Largest pilot 10th-percentile minimum margin under the primary specification.
selection_rule.moderate_evidence: Positive-margin configuration whose median minimum margin is closest to score slack plus 0.015; ties use the smaller configuration id.
selection_rule.degraded: Smallest pilot 90th-percentile minimum margin under the primary specification.

claims.target_population: Equal mixture of the registered positive and negative CDC indicator strata.
claims.reliability_interpretation: At least four in five independent full-pipeline releases satisfy every primary requirement.
claims.score_slack_selection: Choose the smallest common slack whose projected invalid-score allowance is at most 0.04 on the sealed target; break ties by the smaller slack. The practical limits do not change.
claims.headline_rule: The primary specification alone determines the headline decision. Strict and permissive limits are sensitivity analyses. Direct and named bounds are both reported; no uncorrected maximum is used.
claims.desired_but_not_assumed_pattern: High fidelity validates under both modes; moderate evidence validates only under direct shared-target inference; degraded is unresolved or violates at least one requirement. This pattern is a design target, not a condition for reporting.
